notes: Parts 36-40: 50 groups, 45 rows. Merged groups (one row each): Griffin = 'fintech griffin' + 'uk bank griffin' + 'bank behind ubers uk' + 'londons griffin'; Blackbird = 'blackbird' + 'danish startup' (same day, same Series A, EUR 16M vs $17.7M; match inferred, not stated in either headline); Dodai = 'dodai' + 'tokyo gas backs ethiopias'; 4Minds = '4minds' + 'dallas'. Round-up expanded: the Healthcare IT Today headline in group 'duet' also names Vumedi, emitted as a second row under group_key 'duet'. Lookups used: 25 of 25 (WebSearch/WebFetch calls). For rows that needed a lookup, evidence spans that are not in the stored title/snippet/text are quoted from the fetched publisher page, a search-result headline, or the search-result summary of the URLs added to source_urls; investor lists taken from search summaries (Drogue, geniosAI Zoom/General Catalyst, Atomarine, WhiteMatter, Valkryn, Arva participants, Surf, C2i) are less certain than fetched text. 'scottsdale startup' resolved to XpertDox (Pulse 2.0, Nov 11). 'fresh off 20m series' is a hiring release; the WhiteMatter Series A itself was reported on 2026-11-10 (Blumberg Capital lead) and may duplicate a WhiteMatter row from another part. Valkryn: headline $17M is total funding; the row records the $15M seed (plus an earlier $2M pre-seed). Accountable: $20M is total funding including the seed round. Delphina: new round is $7.5M ($15M is total funding). geniosAI: $19.1M is combined seed and Series A; HQ San Jose per most sources, Dealroom says Santa Clara. Vumedi: sources conflict on amount ($104M in the candidate headline and two sources, $140M on TheSaaSNews); kept $104M, exact announcement date not confirmed. ODAIA: release says headquartered in Toronto with a Boston office; dateline is Boston so hq_country is US per the contract. Arva AI: Business Wire dateline New York (also operates from London). Stale re-coverage kept with the true date and exclude_reason 'not-funding' (the validator will reject these as older than 120 days): Surf (round announced 2025-12-10) and C2i Semiconductors (Series A announced 2026-02-15). Unresolved: QuikTech and Islo HQ unknown (Islo's parent Incredibuild is Tel Aviv-based); the Stock Titan cross-border payments company could not be named; Fort Technology/Nexera HQ unknown; Raise3D HQ conflicts (Irvine CA vs Shanghai) and the $15M Series C could not be dated independently (a $15.8M Series C closed in 2022, an undated $15M C2+ round also appears); Mawsool, SandBaseAI HQ unknown (amount hint below the lookup threshold). From background knowledge rather than article text: hq_country for OSMUNDA, WEIBUILD, Guance Cloud (CN), Zya (GB), Raise3D; hq_city for Dodai, Traitomic, Hyliion, Vumedi; Traitomic round type Series A comes from the publisher URL slug. Guance Cloud and Human Biome set is_ai_ml false without a lookup (non-US, budget spent). Bopu Semiconductor amount is 'several hundred million yuan' (undisclosed figure); bucket set to Early Stage Venture by default. Clawlab 'Pre-A3' mapped to Venture - Unspecified. Hadean Energy $15M is AUD (ARENA grant). Mis-resolved candidate pages ignored as text: Wikipedia (Olivia Rodrigo), Lonely Planet (Griffin), duet.org (a different Duet), 4minds.ai/about (404).
